content.lede: Software developer with 3+ years of experience building web platforms and internal tools for enterprise and public-sector clients. I work across the full stack, from responsive front ends to APIs and automated data workflows, with a growing focus on cloud and artificial intelligence.
content.a1: I work across the whole stack: interfaces people enjoy using, the APIs behind them, and the automation that keeps data moving. I like taking a messy process and turning it into something simple.
content.a2: I hold a BSc in Maritime Navigation from the Naval Academy in Varna, where I built a foundation in mathematics, electronic systems and working under pressure. I moved into software through SoftUni’s professional software engineering programme and have worked as a developer since 2023.
content.a3: I learn by building. Outside work I develop side projects such as a karaoke app, a disco light controller and an MCP server for Google Tasks, and I'm currently deepening my knowledge of data and machine learning.
content.e1: Front-end and back-end features for large client platforms: reusable UI components, CMS and API work, automated data updates, production support and code reviews.
content.e2: Workflow logic and UI improvements for internal risk and vulnerability tracking tools built on low-code platforms.
content.e3: Naval Academy, Varna. Navigation, mathematics and electronic systems, followed by a professional software engineering diploma.
